## What changed since `fork-2026.09.29-4aca2dd`

**Runs**
- With several apps running, the run metrics window has a tab for each one,
  with its own charts, process tree, threads and goroutines. The status bar
  plaque adds up CPU, memory and processes over all of them and says how many
  runs there are.
- "Stop all" and the running count include every run that is going, however it
  was started — from the tasks modal or the gutter as well as from the list.
- Restart starts the configuration itself. It no longer stops the run and then
  opens a picker after the tasks file has been edited, and "Restart all" no
  longer opens that picker once per run.
- The run count is a badge on the corner of the run controls instead of a word
  that the title bar cut off.
- Several runs that cannot start each say why, instead of only the last one.
